insights.summary: When the AI Voice Agent transfers to a live agent, the details it collected do not arrive, so callers repeat themselves.
insights.quote: The caller already told the agent their address, and half the time their account number or the policy number off the proposal, and then they get to a rep and the rep asks for all of it again.

insights.summary: Invoca offline call conversions reach Google Ads one to three days after the call, so Smart Bidding optimizes on incomplete data.
insights.quote: They asked me why conversions show up every few days instead of as they come in, because Smart Bidding is making decisions on data that's two days stale.
